name: Omnibus Princess
original_name: オムニバスプリンセス
source:
You have been inside a tower since the day you were born.
Many stories exist within the books inside that tower.
One day, you—who have never known the outside world—meet a mysterious man named Ornit.
He asks you, “Don’t you want to see the world outside the tower?”
Thus, you become capable of viewing the world outside the tower.
The world spread beyond the tower is surprising…
You become the heroine of the world outside the tower and go on a journey to find your own happiness.
translation:
从你出生的那天起，你就一直在塔里。
塔内的书籍中存在着许多故事。
有一天，从未了解过外面世界的你遇到了一位名叫奥尼特的神秘男子。
他问你：“你不想看看塔外的世界吗？”
这样，你就能够看到塔外的世界了。
塔外的世界令人惊讶……
你成为塔外世界的女主角，踏上寻找属于自己的幸福的旅程。
